governingNote: CLAUDE.md commit rules (the identity rule this PR adds), plus the operator's request: 'commits should be as vilosource, not the oneio account; ensure there is a git hook to ensure it'.

findings.summary: merge, cherry-pick, revert, rebase and commit-tree never run pre-commit, so OneIO commits could still be made: pre-push checks every outgoing commit; pre-merge-commit runs the pre-commit check (9212dfe)
outside contributors blocked with no opt-out: git config vfkb.identityGuard off (9212dfe)
stale CLAUDE.md claim of a global commit-msg hook corrected (9212dfe)
branches/worktrees without .githooks are unguarded until rebased onto main (the local user.email still protects them)
scripts/install-git-hooks.mjs has no test (probed by hand)
new-branch push falls back to 'not on any remote-tracking ref'; with origin/main >~179 commits stale, main's historical optiscan / old-noreply commits are refused
bot-author allowance untested (M5 survives); the release-chain new-branch push relies on it
annotated tag's tagger identity not checked

ruledOut: --amend: git hands the amended commit's original author to pre-commit, so amending a OneIO commit is refused
SessionEnd auto-commit (git commit -o) as OneIO is refused; session-end fails open (reason 'error'), brain stays staged
relative core.hooksPath resolves per worktree root; works from subdirectories and linked worktrees
git var strips angle brackets from names, so a crafted name cannot spoof the email; a git var failure fails closed
installer is a no-op under CI (npm ci/pack/publish in workflows); 'files: [dist]' keeps it out of the package
pre-push: outer read loop keeps state; empty list passes; multi-ref pushes name the offending ref; force-push rsha..lsha includes rewritten commits; tags peel to commits
real push shapes pass: topic push to a URL, release-chain empty commit, branch rebased on stale-by-30 main

mutations.mutation: outer loop in a subshell loses state

mutationsNote: The bot-author allowance mutation survives (open finding R2-m2).
